action.action-desc: Mr. Fitzpatrick (for himself, Ms. Perez, and Mr. Bacon) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Ways and Means, and in addition to the Committees on Foreign Affairs, and Intelligence (Permanent Select), for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned

form.official-title: To amend the Ending Importation of Russian Oil Act to prohibit the Office of Foreign Assets Control from issuing a waiver with respect to importation of Russian energy products, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Ronald Reagan Peace Through Strength Act of 2026.

section.header: Prohibition on waiver for importation of Russian energy products
section.text: Section 2 of the Ending Importation of Russian Oil Act (22 U.S.C. 8923 note) is amended—

paragraph.text: by striking All products and inserting the following:
by adding at the end the following:

subsection.text: The Office of Foreign Assets Control may not issue any waiver or general license for the purpose of importing any such product.
The Secretary of the Treasury may not expend any funds for the purpose of an agreement that violates a provision of this Act.

Russia-related General License 135, Authorizing Transactions Related to the Sale, Delivery, Offloading, and Importation of Diesel Fuel of Russian Federation Origin, issued by the Office of Foreign Assets Control of the Department of the Treasury, shall have no force or effect.

The Secretary of the Treasury may not authorize any transaction otherwise prohibited by law that is ordinarily incident and necessary to the sale, delivery, or offloading of crude oil or petroleum products of the Russian Federation.

section.text: Section 102A(j) of the National Security Act of 1947 (50 U.S.C. 3024(j)) is amended—

paragraph.text: by striking Under the direction and inserting the following:
by adding at the end the following new paragraph:

subparagraph.text: The Director shall ensure that each head of a relevant element of the intelligence community, as determined by the Director, provides to the Government of Ukraine intelligence support, including information, intelligence, and imagery collection authorized under this Act or other applicable provisions of law, specifically intended or reasonably expected to defend or retake the territory of Ukraine from the Russian Federation.

Each head of an element of the intelligence community shall submit to the congressional intelligence committees a notification of any interruption in intelligence support provided to the Government of Ukraine by that element by not later than 24 hours after the date on which such interruption begins.
